content_sections.heading: About Rajasthan University
content_sections.text: The University of Rajasthan is a university on JLN Marg in Jaipur. These posts are in Project XIV of the Department of Sociology. The project is titled "Sustainable Livelihood Choices and Capacity Building among People Living with HIV in Rajasthan State" and is funded by the RUSA 2.0 Programme MIRD, GOI. Dr. Amithy Jasrotia is the project's Principal Investigator.

content_sections.heading: Rajasthan University Post Doctoral Fellow and Project Assistant Eligibility 2026
content_sections.text: Essential: A Ph.D. Degree in Sociology/ Anthropology/ Public Health/ MBA (Health & Hospital Management) from a recognized University. Desirable: Excellent knowledge of academic writing, field work technique and data processing Knowledge of SPSS, Atlas t-i or SAS will be recommended Publication proof skill Essential: Masters in Sociology/ Anthropology/ Social Work/ Public Health/ Statistics/ Development Studies/ MBA (Health & Hospital Management) from a recognized University/ Institution. Desirable: Field work experience and the ability to communicate in the Rajasthani dialect. See the official notification for the full eligibility details of each post.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Applications are screened first. Only shortlisted candidates are called for an interview, and they are told by email at the address given in their bio-data. No TA/DA is paid for attending the interview.

content_sections.heading: Service Conditions
content_sections.text: The engagement is temporary/contractual and lasts 4 months, within the RUSA 2.0 research project. The University reserves the right to end the contract of non-performing candidates at any time without prior notice.

faq.question: Q1. How many posts are in this University of Rajasthan recruitment?
faq.answer: There are 4 posts: 2 for Post Doctoral Fellow and 2 for Project Assistant.

faq.question: Q2. What is the research project about?
faq.answer: The project is titled "Sustainable Livelihood Choices and Capacity Building among People Living with HIV in Rajasthan State". It is Project XIV in the Department of Sociology.

faq.question: Q3. Who funds the project?
faq.answer: It is funded by the RUSA 2.0 Programme MIRD, GOI.

faq.question: Q4. How long is the appointment?
faq.answer: The appointment is temporary/contractual for 4 months. The University can end the contract of a non-performing candidate at any time without prior notice.

faq.question: Q5. Can I apply for Project Assistant with an MBA?
faq.answer: Yes, if your MBA is in Health & Hospital Management. That MBA is also accepted for the Post Doctoral Fellow post.

faq.question: Q6. Which software skills help for the Post Doctoral Fellow post?
faq.answer: Knowledge of SPSS, Atlas t-i or SAS is a desirable skill, along with academic writing, field work technique and data processing.

faq.question: Q7. Does knowing Rajasthani help?
faq.answer: Yes, for Project Assistant applicants. The ability to communicate in the Rajasthani dialect and field work experience are listed as desirable.

faq.question: Q8. How will I know if I am called for an interview?
faq.answer: Only shortlisted candidates are told about the interview, by email at the address in their bio-data.

faq.question: Q9. Will travel costs for the interview be paid?
faq.answer: No. The notice says no TA/DA will be paid to shortlisted candidates for the interview.
